name: Quick Links
description: Add admin-configurable shortcuts to the Mattermost product switcher menu. Each shortcut opens its URL in a new browser tab and registers a matching slash command, so mobile users (no menu) can get the same link by typing the trigger.

settings_schema.header: Adds admin-configurable web pages to the Mattermost product switcher menu (where Channels / Boards / Playbooks live). Clicking an item opens the URL in a new browser tab. Each item also registers a slash command, so mobile users (no product switcher on mobile) can get the link by typing the trigger.

settings.help_text: Each row becomes one entry in the product switcher menu and one slash command. Drag the handle to reorder. Reload the Mattermost UI after saving for menu changes to take effect (slash commands update live).
